phases.name: Admission & Takeover
phases.description: Admission-order verification, statutory commencement controls, takeover and initial communications.

phases.name: Public Announcement
phases.description: Form A preparation, publication and proof controls under Regulation 6.

phases.name: Claims & Verification
phases.description: Claim intake, acknowledgement, scrutiny, verification, decision, revision and List of Creditors controls.

phases.name: CoC Eligibility
phases.description: Financial-creditor eligibility, related-party review, voting calculation and class-creditor controls.

phases.name: CoC Constitution
phases.description: Versioned CoC constitution, report and claim-change reconstitution controls.

phases.name: CoC Meetings & Voting
phases.description: First and subsequent CoC meeting lifecycle, notice, agenda, attendance, minutes, voting and action tracking.

phases.name: Operations, Valuation, IM & VDR
phases.description: Controlled operational registers, valuation, information memorandum and restricted virtual data room access.

phases.name: Transaction Audit & Avoidance
phases.description: Manual transaction-audit evidence, layered professional review, avoidance decisions and continuing application tracking.

phases.name: EOI, PRA & Resolution Plan
phases.description: Versioned EOI, PRA eligibility, bid package, plan review, CoC selection and NCLT approval controls.

steps.activity: Download and circulate the admission order; verify effective date, moratorium, IRP name and directions.

evidence_requirements.description: Confirmed PDF admission order with source and date.

steps.activity: Record the moratorium and create a prohibited-action alert for staff.
Verify IRP appointment, registration, AFA and contact particulars.
Create the electronic and physical CIRP master file.
Generate the statutory and internal compliance calendar.

deadline_rule.rule_text: Generate the baseline calendar from confirmed T

steps.activity: Assign staff owner, checker, legal coordinator and escalation structure.
Notify the suspended Board and KMP that management powers stand suspended and vest in the IRP.
steps.task_title: Issue takeover letter to suspended management

evidence_requirements.description: Email, postal or acknowledged service proof.

steps.activity: Demand books, records, assets, passwords, contracts and statutory information.
steps.task_title: Send information requisition to suspended management

steps.activity: Seek written cooperation and identify nodal persons from suspended management.
Take control or custody of available assets and records and document gaps.
steps.task_title: Document takeover of assets and records

evidence_requirements.description: Photos, inventory or signed takeover record.

steps.activity: Assess whether the business is operating and identify immediate going-concern risks.
steps.task_title: Prepare initial operations and going-concern note

steps.activity: Write to banks for statements, balances, facilities, liens and the signatory or control process.
steps.task_title: Send bank intimations and access requests

evidence_requirements.description: Sent communication and bank response where received.

steps.activity: Issue payment instructions to material debtors and customers where appropriate.
Notify critical suppliers and seek continuity of essential and critical supplies.
Communicate CIRP commencement and continuity instructions to employees.
Notify key tax and statutory authorities and seek records or dues where relevant.

evidence_requirements.description: Income-tax, GST, PF, ESIC or other authority acknowledgement.

steps.activity: Notify electricity, water, telecom and other essential providers where needed.
Verify insurance policies, premium status, insured assets and claims.
Obtain the complete litigation list and contact existing advocates.
steps.task_title: Obtain litigation register and counsel details

steps.activity: Secure ERP, accounting, email, domain, cloud, DSC and backup access.
steps.task_title: Secure digital systems and backup access

steps.activity: Make the Public Announcement inviting claims.
steps.depends_on_description: Prescribed format and confirmed foundational case particulars

deadline_rule.rule_text: Public Announcement must be made no later than three days from IRP appointment / confirmed T

steps.activity: Publish in English and regional-language newspapers at the required locations.

evidence_requirements.description: Full-page newspaper copies and publication invoices.

steps.activity: Upload or display the Public Announcement on the corporate debtor website and relevant mechanism where applicable.
steps.task_title: Upload Public Announcement and preserve proof

steps.activity: Activate the case-scoped Claims Register.
Acknowledge the Claim and allot a stable per-case Claim reference.
Confirm creditor category and statutory Claim form.
Review prescribed form, authorization, security and supporting records using the configurable checklist.
Record and track a clarification or missing-information query.
Track the configured initial Claim submission deadline and flag later receipts without rejecting them.

deadline_rule.rule_text: Initial submission period configured as T+14; legal configuration remains versioned.

steps.day_trigger_text: After Claim is ready for verification
steps.activity: Verify amount, interest, security, limitation, set-off, books and supporting evidence.

deadline_rule.rule_text: Configured verification control at T+21 (seven days after the initial T+14 Claim date).

steps.activity: Confirm related-party status and preserve reason/evidence.
Record the human-confirmed admitted, partly admitted, not admitted or under-verification decision without overwriting history.
Prepare, approve and record service of the Claim decision communication.

evidence_requirements.description: Required before the communication is marked SENT.

steps.day_trigger_text: After one or more Claim decisions
steps.activity: Derive and version the List of Creditors from canonical Claims and decision versions.

evidence_requirements.description: Immutable formal List of Creditors snapshot.

steps.activity: Record the prescribed display or filing mechanism and evidence without automating filing.

steps.day_trigger_text: Claim received after configured initial deadline
steps.activity: Review a late Claim without automatic admission or rejection.

steps.day_trigger_text: On new evidence or revised Claim
steps.activity: Preserve and review the revised Claim version and downstream effects.
Track claimed and verified security status, evidence and unresolved dispute.
Confirm eligibility of admitted Financial Creditor Claims with full decision traceability.
Calculate voting shares deterministically from admitted eligible Financial Creditor debt.
Track creditor class membership and whether an authorised representative process requires review.
Track AR requirement, candidate/selection, documents, filing requirement and evidence.
Confirm and preserve an immutable CoC Constitution version derived from Claims.
Generate and approve the retained-template report certifying CoC Constitution; record filing separately.

evidence_requirements.description: Retained generated DOCX artifact and version.

steps.day_trigger_text: When a later Claim change affects CoC
steps.activity: Review the downstream effect and confirm a new Constitution version without mutating history.

steps.day_trigger_text: After CoC Constitution; legal timing requires configured DeadlineRule
steps.activity: Create, schedule and issue the first CoC Meeting Notice from a confirmed CoC Constitution.
Prepare versioned Agenda, notes, supporting papers and proposed resolutions; freeze the issued version.
Record a deterministic quorum calculation from the frozen meeting-member snapshot and a versioned rule.
Record attendance, representative authority and voting entitlement against the frozen snapshot.
Record proposed and final wording for continuation, replacement or other IRP/RP decision.
Record a structured CIRP cost statement and supporting documents for ratification or approval.
Record structured operational status only to support the meeting Agenda and Minutes.
Record professional scope, proposed fees, support and linked resolution without creating a vendor-management system.
Assemble retained-template Minutes from office-provided agenda-wise factual text and immutable snapshots.
Record a structured e-voting session and actual external/manual vote inputs from frozen voting shares.
Calculate and finalize deterministic voting results and link meeting decisions to action items and existing tasks.
Record a professional-reviewed going-concern assessment, assumptions and cash requirement.
Maintain forecast versus actual cash flow, payment register and bank reconciliation evidence.
Maintain debtor-wise receivable, follow-up, collection and recovery evidence.
Record controlled asset movement and supporting evidence.
Track statutory obligation, filing evidence and professional review status without legal-date guessing.
Log alleged action and professional moratorium assessment; never auto-conclude an exception.
Maintain requisitions, responses, reminders, deficiencies and evidence chronology.
Create a fact-linked escalation chronology and filing record only after professional confirmation.
Record asset-protection incident, evidence, action and closure review.
Record proposal, terms, drawdown and supporting approval evidence.
Record system suggestion and separate professional approval determination.
Maintain asset-class requirement, quotations, comparison, appointment, acceptance and assignment controls.
Verify declaration and relationship disclosure before enabling an assignment.
Record data pack, inspection, information request and access evidence.
Record restricted valuation-report receipt, review and storage reference.
Maintain query, clarification, response and closure evidence.
Create a source-linked IM section checklist with completeness and review status.
Version IM content and record professional finalisation; legacy office format requires verified conversion before generation.
Track recipient, undertaking issue/signature/verification and source document.
Maintain VDR index, recipient access grant/revocation and access log without duplicating files.
Define professional-confirmed review scope and look-back periods without system legal inference.
Maintain evidence-led preferential transaction review; final classification stays with RP/legal.
Maintain evidence-led undervalue review; final classification stays with RP/legal.
Maintain extortionate-credit review and permit confirmed no-finding completion.
Maintain neutral narrative Section 66 review; no system fraud accusation or liability conclusion.
Confirm/link related parties and review material transactions with source evidence.
Record distinct RP review, legal review and confirmed action decision before application preparation.
Track application, pleadings, hearing and orders independently of the main CIRP outcome.
Prepare case-specific eligibility criteria and a versioned EOI process for required CoC approval.
steps.task_title: Prepare EOI process and eligibility criteria

steps.activity: Publish the approved Invitation for EOI and retain final document and publication evidence.

evidence_requirements.description: Uploaded final EOI and publication/dispatch proof.

steps.activity: Register each EOI, exact receipt timestamp, channel, checklist, documents and deposit evidence.
Conduct configurable evidence-led eligibility review for PRA, connected persons and every consortium member; professional/legal conclusion required.
Generate, approve and issue an immutable provisional PRA list from confirmed eligibility reviews.
Record objection, evidence, review and reasoned professional/legal decision without altering the provisional snapshot.
Create and issue a new immutable final PRA list with review and objection basis.
Version and obtain CoC approval for uploaded RFRP and structured Evaluation Matrix without inventing criteria or legal text.
Issue frozen RFRP, Matrix and IM versions only to final-eligible PRAs with verified confidentiality undertaking and controlled VDR access.
Maintain private/shared PRA queries, responses, site visits, VDR changes and immutable process addenda.
Register each confidential Resolution Plan version, timestamp, channel, document package and security without overwriting prior versions.
Perform configurable clause/page/evidence-based Section 30(2) review; RP/legal records the final conclusion.
Create a fresh eligibility-review version using current declarations, connected persons, ownership and consortium facts.
Record RFRP, Section 30, Section 29A, financial, implementation or security queries and exact Plan references.
Apply reproducible Decimal arithmetic and authorized manual scores against the exact approved Matrix and Plan versions.
Run only the configured negotiation or challenge mechanism with immutable rounds, submissions and timestamps.
Link exact compliant Plan versions, reviews and evaluation to the existing CoC agenda and meeting engine.
Link the exact Plan version and CoC snapshot to the existing versioned voting result.
Record the Successful RA separately and gate NCLT readiness on verified performance security where required.
Assemble a source-linked application workspace using the selected Plan, reviews, vote, security and uploaded professional documents; no pleading is fabricated.
steps.task_title: Prepare and file Plan Approval Application

steps.activity: Reuse the existing Application and Hearing systems to track objections, affidavits, compliance queries, directions and orders.
